The advance of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] was a campaign to invade the holdings of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] near [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellia/Duro-bound campaign makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.<ref name="EA" />
